title: Visual Tool Builders — Node-RED
description: Flow-based tool builder for IoT utilities.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for Node-RED, a visual tool builders. Flow-based tool builder for IoT utilities. Category: Tools That Build Tools.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output. The demonstration exercises the tool's core behavior: [Node-RED] visually built tool 'csv-cleaner': generated 240 lines, runs OK.

3. Inputs and outputs. This class of tool takes tool specifications and schemas and produces working tools and generators. The demonstration's input is a scenario selector (0-7); its output is the human-readable result line kept in demo.output.

4. Execution instructions. Requires Node.js 18 or later and nothing else. Save demo.program to a file, append a call such as console.log(demoMain(0, 'demo')), and run it with node. No dependencies are installed and no network is used.

5. Tests and examples. This record's demonstration scenario was executed in Node.js and its real output captured in demo.output. Re-running demoMain with the same scenario index reproduces it byte-for-byte.
